notes: Catalog services matched by an active Landing Category now get automatically translated into every active language, not just whatever single language the pricing API happens to return names in - each sync seeds a default-language service_translations row for them (if one isn't already there from the HTML scraper), which the existing hourly services:refresh-catalog run auto-queues for AI translation into every active language, same pipeline every other service already uses. The Catalog pricing sync API server (SEO > Settings) is picked from your existing Free Service Gateway > API Servers list instead of typing a separate smm.plus API key/host - add or reuse a server there (e.g. an 'SMM Plus Main' row pointing at https://smm.plus/api/v2) and select it. Adds a public GET /api/services endpoint (restricted to the smm.plus CORS origin) that serves a cached copy of that server's retail service catalog (price/min/max, synced daily) filtered by an admin-configured landing-page category slug, with optional geo/lang filtering - for SEO landing pages that currently hardcode pricing. New SEO > Catalog Services (synced list, manual sync action, admin-set source label) and SEO > Landing Categories (slug-to-category mapping) admin pages. Also corrects the earlier 1.27.30 update, which was mistakenly built from an older codebase and broke the Analytics page - this build includes all of 1.28-1.31's analytics/purchase-tracking/Telegram-view-top-up work intact. Requires 'Update database' for two new tables (catalog_services, landing_service_categories).
